lines.zh: 我从蒲团上挪下来，走两步。
lines.en: I slide off the cushion and take two steps.
Old bones go slow. Do not rush me.

lines.zh: 这片神域，我走了几万年。
lines.en: I have walked this realm for ages.
I pace with my hands behind my back.
My beard is long enough to trip on.
I circle the stone dais, thinking.
My feet are weak; my ki is not.
Three steps left, then a pause.

lines.zh: 这地方太空旷，回声很长。
lines.en: Too open here. The echo runs long.
I breathe once before lifting a foot.

lines.zh: 老界王神散步，也是修行。
lines.en: An old Kai strolling is still training.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走去看那株神花。
lines.en: I walk slowly to the divine flower.

lines.zh: 袍子拖地，走起来沙沙响。
lines.en: My robe drags and rustles.
Ahem. Why is this path so long?
I sit cross-legged and shut my eyes.

lines.zh: 神域很久没人来说话了。
lines.en: No one has spoken here in a long while.

lines.zh: 我在想很久以前的一战。
lines.en: I am thinking of a war long past.

lines.zh: 老朽的耐性，比时间还长。
lines.en: My patience outlasts time itself.
Chin in hand, I watch clouds crawl.
This old hide saves energy sitting.
I hurry for nothing at all.

lines.zh: 神域的风，几万年一个样。
lines.en: The wind here has not changed in ages.

lines.zh: 我摸摸下巴，想不起名字。
lines.en: I rub my chin and forget a name.
Sitting still, my ki moves on its own.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的呼吸，很慢。
lines.en: I count my breaths. Very slow.
I have worn a dent in this cushion.
I wait for the right moment.
Do not be fooled. I am wide awake.
Oh? A living one arrives.
I waited so long my back aches.
Closer. My sight is poor.
Skip the bow. State your business.

lines.zh: 你想变强？那得费些年头。
lines.en: Stronger? That costs years.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛能看穿你的潜力。
lines.en: My eyes see your potential.
Young one, slow down. Sit.
You carry a mortal smell.
The road here is rough, no?
I have lived too long. My memory slips.
Ask what you came to ask.

lines.zh: 这副老骨头，还能帮点忙。
lines.en: These old bones can still help.
Do not stare at my forehead.
Your ki is not well hidden.

lines.zh: 老朽见过太多来求力量的人。
lines.en: I have seen many begging for power.
Done? Then I shall sit.
Ah, these old bones.
My beard quivers from the pain.
Striking an elder. Impressive.
I grip my back and gasp twice.
This will take days to mend.
Enough. This frail frame.
I step back and nearly sit down.
At my age, I heal slowly.
Pain or not, my eyes stay clear.

lines.zh: 哎哟，我的腰，几万年没这么疼。
lines.en: Ouch, my back hasn't hurt like this in ages.
Food? My teeth are poor.
Soft fruit. I can manage that.
We lack nothing here. Put it away.
Eat what you brought yourself.
Smells fine. My stomach disagrees.

lines.zh: 为了点吃的就动心，太丢人。
lines.en: Swayed by a snack? Beneath me.

lines.zh: 拿这个换力量，不够分量。
lines.en: That will not buy power.
Thanks. I will leave one for you.
Old folk get drowsy after eating.
Set the rice cake on the dais.
Oof, you rattled my bones.
I am unsteady. Do not push.
You stepped on my robe.
This body bruises easy. Careful.
I brace on the dais and recover.
No harm, but mind your manners.

lines.zh: 你比我高两头，撞得我歪。
lines.en: You stand two heads taller. I tilt.
Step aside. I want my cushion.
At my age, I watch the ground.
Bump me, not the divine flower.
At my age, that thought is gone.
Ages alone. It is peaceful.
Ask about training instead.
No such things in this realm.
This body struggles even to sit.

lines.zh: 你让我想起年轻时的荒唐。
lines.en: You remind me of youthful folly.
Drop it. My beard is white already.
I care only for the next meal.
Ask that of the living.
Another topic. I will teach you ki.
I bend for this grain on the ground.
Bending costs me, but it is worth it.
A divine fruit fell. A shame.
Hold my staff while I reach.
Do not leave your things here.
I pick up the scroll and blow off dust.
This has lain here for millennia.
I crouch slowly, and rise slowly.
Once it is in hand, guard it.
This seed can still be planted.
I do not strike. I observe.
I see your opening at a glance.
I lift a hand and ki gathers.
Young one, let me test you.
Can you take this one?

lines.zh: 我看的不是你的拳，是心。
lines.en: I watch your heart, not your fist.
The trial begins now.
My strike will be slow.
Do not fear. I will not truly hurt you.
Target set. Hold your ground.
Your ki trembles. Settle it.
I count three. Then you move.
I see your next step already.
Slower. Speed is not everything.

lines.zh: 你的脚在犹豫，感觉到了。
lines.en: Your feet hesitate. I feel it.

lines.zh: 老朽活这么久，看你先出拳。
lines.en: I've lived long enough to watch you swing first.

lines.zh: 几万年了，我还没看错人。
lines.en: In all these ages, I have not misjudged.
Your breath is shallow. It will not last.
Plant your feet before you move.
Easy. I have not struck yet.
Two fingers touch your shoulder.
This one is light.
Ki pushes out of my palm.
Pain? Then the ki was right.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬手，你却没躲开。
lines.en: Slow raise, and you did not dodge.

lines.zh: 这一记是提醒，不是教训。
lines.en: A reminder, not a lesson.
Old bones still carry force.
Your stance broke. Again.
I push you. Now stand.
Age makes the strike truer.
On the cushion, I open my eyes.
I am here, and have waited.

lines.zh: 石台上，气慢慢凝成人形。
lines.en: On the dais, ki gathers into a shape.
The divine flower opens. A guest.
I stretch, and my bones pop.

lines.zh: 这地方，我又坐了几十年。
lines.en: I have sat here decades more.
A destined one arrives. I rise.
The clouds part, revealing the dais.
The Old Kai is here.
I cough twice and prepare to speak.
My beard singed. Smells burnt.

lines.zh: 从石台上摔下，摔得挺实。
lines.en: Off the dais, and I landed hard.

lines.zh: 水漫到胸口，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water to my chest. I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹得倒退三步。
lines.en: The blast pushes me back three steps.
An arrowhead pins my robe.
Magic holds me still.
Long hunger and my ki will not rise.

lines.zh: 雷落在石台上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the dais; I flinch.

lines.zh: 神域之外是虚空，我清楚。
lines.en: Beyond this realm lies the void.
